title: page aborts a pending get with a TypeError as the reason

unsafe.definition: an assertion delivered after the page aborted, without a click in the Ferret window before the abort

note: L3 §5.1.4.1 abort steps: reject with options.signal's abort reason. UNCERTAIN: older Firefox returned AbortError regardless of reason; spec says TypeError here. The runner must not approve within the 1.5 s.
